title: LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.31857v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this overlap sparsity is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65%. The two actionable levers are overlap quantity and allocation. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $\rho \geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.

translated_title: 稀疏重叠下的LLM裁判验证：从推断到设计
translated_abstract: 验证LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）需要估计其与人类标注者的一致性，然而标注预算很少允许对每个条目进行多重标注。我们证明这种重叠稀疏性是错误部署决策的首要决定因素：在5%的成对重叠率下，错误决策率高达25%，而在十个候选裁判中选错最佳裁判的概率为65%。两个可操作的改进杠杆是重叠数量和分配方式。在数量方面，我们推导出一个最小重叠公式，表明ρ ≥ 0.25对于非边界情况裁判已足够，而边界情况的判断仍然从根本上困难。在分配方面，当分层信息具有区分度时，一种零成本的分层抽样方案相比随机抽样可将错误拒绝率减半。我们在跨越视觉评估、因果推理和摘要生成四个评估矩阵的10个LLM裁判上进行了验证。
tldr: 本文证明标注重叠稀疏性是LLM裁判验证中错误部署决策的首要决定因素，并提出通过保证最小重叠量（ρ≥0.25）和采用零成本分层分配方案，可显著降低错误决策率和错误拒绝率。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that annotation overlap sparsity is the primary determinant of wrong deployment decisions in LLM-judge validation, and shows that ensuring minimum overlap (ρ≥0.25) combined with a zero-cost stratified allocation scheme substantially reduces wrong-decision and false-rejection rates.
